title: QSUBJ agent output (q-subject-confirmer) -- ONE question whose paper printed no section heading
description: ITEM GRANULARITY: one question. Only questions the paper left unheaded reach this step -- where a section heading is printed, scripts/assign_subject.py reads it and no agent is dispatched, because a measurement that can be reproduced beats a judgement that cannot. WHY THE QUESTION NUMBER IS NOT THE ANSWER: NEET usually runs Physics, then Chemistry, then Biology, but TWO of the ten booklets measured here print their sections in a different order -- 2015 Code-A runs Chemistry 1-45, Biology 46-135, Physics 136-192, and 2020 Code-F1 runs Biology 1-90, Physics 91-135, Chemistry 136-180. So `position_guess` in the input is a weak hint with a known failure rate, and `agrees_with_position` is recorded on every answer so that rate can be measured rather than assumed.

branch.description: Biology only; null for Physics and Chemistry. `unsure` is a REAL answer for ecology, biomolecules, cell biology and biotechnology, which sit in both branches in NEET -- forcing one makes the record look decided when the syllabus is not. Chemistry's physical/organic/inorganic branch is b7-chem-branch-sorter's job, not this step's.

why.description: One sentence naming the fact that decides it. Vocabulary appearing in the stem is not a reason: a Biology question about osmotic pressure is still Biology, a Physics question mentioning a cell is still Physics.

agrees_with_position.description: Whether this matches `position_guess`. Recorded so the positional fallback's error rate is measured rather than assumed; a disagreement is how a mislabelled block of a hundred questions gets found.
